description: This file implements a command-line utility function for checking and validating Git reference (ref) name formats, including normalization and specific checks for branch names. It includes helper functions such as collapsing slashes in ref names and handling command-line arguments.

methods.name: char * collapse_slashes(const char * refname)
methods.description: Removes leading slashes and collapses consecutive slashes into a single slash in a reference name string.

methods.name: int check_ref_format_branch(const char * arg)
methods.description: Validates whether a given argument is a valid branch reference name and extracts the branch name.

methods.name: int cmd_check_ref_format(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function invoked for the 'git check-ref-format' command; parses arguments, performs normalization, and validates the reference name.

ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
